title: Bound clean helpers under common target flags (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration, no new κ. In the rational scalar-idempotent model, `t` invertible data targets with a common rational flag, plus any number of clean identity helpers, require at least `mt` paid calls if the frame span has dimension at most `m+1`. Diagonal targets attain this bound with `mt` calls and span `m`.

```text
upper-entry projection:  identity output  ->  r_X + r_Y <= U
diagonal projections:    t active outputs ->  t <= r_X + l_i, t <= r_Y + l_i
rank-one lower frames:   l_1 + l_2 <= E - U  ->  E >= 2t
```

This partially answers open question 1 of unpaidmoon's [PR6338](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6338). The common-flag hypothesis is needed for the proof. The [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19384265) asked about arbitrary invertible targets; the [progress update](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19384279) records the narrower delivered scope. The result was produced by Nick Petalas.

Eumemic's PR288 supplies the model, Ali Romman's PR468 the normalization, projections and flag bound, PR5988 the all-dimensional support split, and unpaidmoon's PR6338 the question and non-two-support cases. Ali Romman's PR4961 already proves the stronger unrestricted-span nine-call bound for three lower-triangular 3-by-3 data targets and one returned register; that special case is not new here. PR4118 supplies a partial dirty-auxiliary span-four bound. Predecessor results are cited inputs and were not re-verified.

## Evidence

Before: PR6338 leaves clean helpers in the two-support block open. After: with a common target flag, the exact rank argument handles any number of data and clean helper registers in all address dimensions.

Local CPython 3.12 checks from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -W error -B research/clean-helper-flag-bound/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/clean-helper-flag-bound/verify.py
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/clean-helper-flag-bound
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/clean-helper-flag-bound --check-source-history
```

Both direct modes return `PASS_CLEAN_HELPER_FLAG_BOUND short_words=178808 identity_words=56 cancellation_calls=6 sharp_calls=4 controls=4`. They enumerate short words in one finite projected alphabet, check the scalar span inequality for each identity word, verify direct and cancellation fixtures and reject a missing cancellation. These controls do not establish the universal theorem. The registered replay and metadata check pass; each registered command ran locally in under two seconds. The committed-byte and source-history check passes at `e7b08ac9ef4ea5b5517d9d325ae6aeae445d3f91`. The selected baseline reports `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY`.

## Limitations

The proof cites PR468, PR5988 and PR6338 for the existing normalization, support split and non-two-support cases. It does not cover targets without a common rational flag, general dirty helper exponents, frame span above `m+1`, interposed address maps, native implementation or a complete supplier invoice. No selected-frontier update or complete multiplication theorem is claimed. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed. No Lean build or selected scientific cold replay was run.

## Open next questions

- Does the two-dimensional bound hold without a common rational flag? Start with two targets whose relative two-by-two matrix has irreducible quadratic characteristic polynomial; their upper projection need not have identity output.
- Can nonzero dirty helper exponents be admitted when their upper projection vanishes? Track their contributions to the diagonal ranks.

## Related open work

- [PR203](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/203) studies a common triangular flag for paid frames; this proof instead assumes a common flag for the data-target ratios and limits frame span.
- [PR6419](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6419) accelerates the PR6338 finite verifier. It does not establish this two-support bound.
- [PR3893](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3893) studies a three-register target in a finite nonabelian algebra; the present proof uses rational additive address frames.

## CI notes

Package selection never ran, and the replay job was skipped. Hosted CI did not certify this result. The finite checks are certified only by the local runs listed above; they do not constitute independent human or formal proof-kernel review.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. **Blast radius:** isolated.

Only the new research package is added. Frozen predecessors and the selected result remain unchanged.
